key_impacts: Harbor walls overtopped by meteotsunami waves
Flooding of shoreline and city streets in Ludington
Shoreline homes, public docks, and cottages damaged
Water intake pumps impacted by rapid water-level change
Up to 2 m water-level fluctuations reported outside the harbor; 0.5 m recorded at harbor gauge
evidence_snippets: On April 13, 2018, meteotsunami waves struck the shores near Ludington, Michigan.
Harbor walls were overtopped; damage to shoreline homes and boat docks; water intake pumps were impacted.
Reports of water level fluctuations of 2 m just outside the harbor; 0.5 m recorded inside.
missing_information: Damage extent not quantified (no counts or monetary losses)
Affected communities beyond Ludington not fully enumerated
